question:
Select the most appropriate idiom for the underlined part in the given sentence:

Amar was left __in a difficult situation__ by his business partners.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"High and dry"** means to be left **in a difficult or stranded situation** without help or resources. (मुश्किल स्थिति में छोड़ देना)

 
 
• **Example: **When the company went bankrupt, many employees were left **high and dry** without any severance pay.
 
 

Therefore, the correct one word substitution is **'High and dry'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Hard and fast **(कठोर और निश्चित): Rules or standards that are fixed and not easily changed.

 
 
• **Example:** There are no** hard and fast** rules for success; it varies from person to person.
 
 
 
• **Head and shoulders above **(काफी बेहतर होना): Significantly better than others.
 
 
• **Example: **Her performance was **head and shoulders** above the rest of the candidates.
 
 
 
• **Heart and soul **(पूरे दिल से): With great energy and enthusiasm.
 
 
• **Example:** She put her **heart and soul** into the project to ensure its success.
 
 

5a:Tb0d,

The correct answer is Option 1)
